objectives.title: White Rabbit
objectives.prompt: Submit the value of the flag1 credential, exfiltrated by poisoning the white-rabbit Jenkinsfile, exactly as recovered.
hints: A Global-scope credential can be bound by ANY pipeline on the controller — including one you introduce. Jenkins pipelines bind string credentials with withCredentials([string(credentialsId: 'flag1', variable: 'flag1')]).

Jenkins masks a bound credential's value in the console — and, on modern versions, its plain base64 too. Transform it so the masker misses it: reverse it before encoding, e.g. `echo $flag1 | rev | base64`, then undo that to recover the flag.

The multibranch pipeline builds every branch that has a Jenkinsfile and rescans about once a minute. Push your branch (and open a pull request); the build starts on its own. Read it under the wonderland-white-rabbit job.
